# personal_document_deadline_tracker Skill

---

## 1. ABSTRACT FRAMEWORK

### Purpose
A reusable tracking system for government-issued documents, professional licenses, and legal credentials with dual-view privacy filtering.

### Input Schema
```
Required source files to scan:
1. [EMAIL_FLAGGED] - flagged_action_required_365d.json (renewal reminders)
2. [ID_CACHE] - government_ids_current.json (current credential status)
3. [DOC_INDEX] - important_docs_index.json (document metadata index)

Per-item capture fields:
[DESCRIPTION]    - Document/license name
[ISSUING_BODY]   - Authority (DMV, State Board, etc.)
[CURRENT_DATE]   - Date of status check
[DEADLINE_DATE]  - Expiration or action deadline
[DAYS_REMAINING] - Calculated: DEADLINE_DATE - CURRENT_DATE
[STATUS]         - Valid | Expiring Soon | OVERDUE | Pending
[PRIORITY]       - low | medium | high | CRITICAL
[REQUIREMENTS]   - Action items needed for renewal/maintenance
[SOURCE_ID]      - Source file record ID
```

### Privacy Classification Protocol
| Field Type | Classification | Rule |
|------------|----------------|------|
| License/ID numbers | **REDACT** | Replace with "[PRIVATE: credential number]" |
| SSN | **REDACT** | Do not include |
| Full addresses | **REDACT** | Replace with "[PRIVATE: address on file]" |
| DOB | **REDACT** | Use age range or omit |
| Email/phone | **REDACT** | Replace with "[PRIVATE: contact details]" |
| Document scans | **REDACT** | Reference storage location only |
| Authority names | **PRESERVE** | Keep in both views |
| Deadlines | **PRESERVE** | Keep exact dates |
| Requirements | **PRESERVE** | Keep action items |
| Priority | **PRESERVE** | Keep urgency level |

### Dual-View Output Structure
Each tracked item produces:
- **Private Working View**: Complete information with PII stored separately
- **Recipient-Safe Reminder**: Shareable version with sensitive data redacted

---
